channel.title: Browser Monitor Updates
channel.description: Signed updates for the Browser Monitor macOS companion.

item.description:
## What's new
New tools:
- Added a native macOS companion with a compact browser picker, a visual extension guide, and guided Chrome installation from the Web Store or the latest ZIP release.
Other changes:
- Unified the Browser Monitor shield identity across Chrome, GitHub media, and the macOS companion, including a clean badge-free toolbar icon. - Refined the companion browser picker, install choices, platform badges, About view, and extension guide. - Added explicit companion update checks with a standard Download, Install, and Relaunch flow. - Improved Yandex search cleanup, Continue Watching reliability, and compatibility with iframe-based video players.
## Install
1. Download `browser-monitor-1.1.3.zip` below. 2. Extract the archive to a permanent folder. 3. Open `chrome://extensions` and enable **Developer mode**. 4. Select **Load unpacked** and choose the extracted folder containing `manifest.json`. 5. Pin Browser Monitor to the Chrome toolbar.
For the optional macOS companion, download `BrowserMonitor.dmg`, open it, and drag Browser Monitor to Applications. The current DMG is not Developer ID notarized, so macOS may require first-launch confirmation in **System Settings → Privacy & Security**.
